motif: Ecto-Verde glowing exhaust grille: every building has at least one slit vent or grille that glows green and breathes a vapor plume. Riveted bone-white rib trim runs along the roofline.

buildings.why: Tallest in the race: four chimneys on a scaffolded nave. Dark body, green grilles.
Stepped stone crypt with a black canvas awning. The Graveyard upgrade grows it into rows of terraced headstones.
A slot cut into the clay with a rim, a swing-crane and an iron hatch. Reads as a hole, with ecto rising from the bottom.
The collapsed silo's lean is the 32px read. It keeps the Cart chain's leaning archetype, braced with timber.
Ribs become dock arches with a gantry crane and a hanging vertebra. The gate-like openings are the second-biggest read in the race.

buildings.colour: pale slate-grey stone with numbered metal tags
buildings.why: The Crypt chain grows into tiered rows of file-drawer headstones. The chapel office sits on top.
The extraction tower holds the elevator cage out askew on a stalk. Constant vapor at the mouth.

buildings.colour: pale grey stone with ecto-green glass
buildings.why: A crown of vent stacks around a master chimney with two side towers. The upgrade changes contour, not scale. Chain archetype is the hollow crown.
A limping cart with an overflowing cage tilts to one side. This starts the leaning chain that continues to Farm and Granary.
Skulls stacked like cannonballs form a pyramid on a steel frame, with a hook crane on top.
The furnace grows the pyramid with a ramp and a riveted jig. Brass and amber distinguish it from the Pile next to it.
The industrial butcher is a long shed with a hook rail through the facade, a low chimney and a resin vat.

buildings.colour: dull straw-yellow thatch over grey timber
buildings.why: A rural house with a dumped thatch roof sags to one side. It keeps the Cart chain's lean, and the scarecrow post adds a vertical accent.
A chapel whose exposed bone framing forms a ribbed open crown. Skull drawers line the walls.
A low two-body hall with curved exhaust pipes at the sides forms an open crown. Stays low and bipartite per UND-07.

buildings.colour: kiln-orange brick with an iron spiral stair
buildings.why: A vertical brick furnace drum with a horizontal throw mouth, not a needle chimney.
